LESSON: KENYAN FOLK SONGS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.9: Kenyan Folk Songs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Kenyan Folk Songs. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is the role of folk songs in Kenyan society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. classify folk songs in Kenyan communities
2. perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques
3. appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: KENYAN FOLK SONGS
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Kenyan Folk Songs helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: KENYAN FOLK SONGS
Study Kenyan Folk Songs like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Classify folk songs in Kenyan communities

What this means
In this part you learn to classify folk songs in Kenyan communities. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: classify folk songs in Kenyan communities.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Kenyan Folk Songs” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can classify folk songs in Kenyan communities. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques

What this means
In this part you learn to perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Kenyan Folk Songs in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Kenyan Folk Songs is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Kenyan Folk Songs” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: classify folk songs in Kenyan communities)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Kenyan Folk Songs in your own words. (skill: perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Kenyan Folk Songs to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: classify folk songs in Kenyan communities.
3. Practise this skill: perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Kenyan Folk Songs from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Kenyan Folk Songs: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Kenyan Folk Songs?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the role of folk songs in Kenyan society?
2. How can performances of Kenyan folk songs be made interesting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Kenyan Folk Songs means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: classify folk songs in Kenyan communities.
5. Be able to: perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
